name: CV kit
description: One prompt that finds the mistake most likely to get your CV rejected, three follow-ups and a 5-point checklist. Tested on ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.

page.title: The CV check
page.sub: The one prompt that finds the mistake most likely to get your CV rejected, three follow-ups, and the 5-point checklist. Tested on ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini.
page.prompt_how: Swap in the job, then paste your CV underneath.
page.prompt_note: "Answer in 2 sentences" keeps it to the one thing that matters.
page.tested_title: We tested it on all three
page.tested_text: Our test CV had one planted typo: **gmial.com** instead of gmail.com. ChatGPT and Claude caught it straight away. Gemini missed it on that run, but flagged vague bullet points instead.
page.tip: **The tip:** ask more than one AI. They catch different things.

prompt: I'm applying for a [job title] job. What's the one mistake on my CV most likely to get it rejected? Answer in 2 sentences.

followups.label: Fix vague bullets
followups.prompt: Rewrite my bullet points as achievements. Don't make up any numbers: ask me for the real ones first.
followups.note: The "don't make up numbers" part matters: a CV with invented numbers is worse than a vague one.
followups.email_note: Invented numbers are worse than vague ones.

followups.label: Match the job advert
followups.prompt: Compare my CV with this job advert. List the skills and keywords it asks for that my CV doesn't show yet.
followups.note: Paste the advert under it. Only add what you can back up.

followups.label: Catch the typos
followups.prompt: Check every contact detail, date and job title on my CV for typos or anything that doesn't add up.
followups.note: This is the one that catches a broken email address.

checklist.title: Contact details that work
checklist.detail: Send yourself a test email from the address on your CV.

checklist.title: A real number in every bullet you can
checklist.detail: "Grew followers 40% in 3 months" beats "responsible for social media".

checklist.title: Matched to the advert's own words
checklist.detail: Use their words for the skills you really have.

checklist.title: Dates that line up
checklist.detail: No overlaps or mismatched months between jobs.

checklist.title: No gaps left unexplained
checklist.detail: One honest line covers it: study, travel, caring, a project.

safety: Use a **temporary chat** in ChatGPT or Gemini, or **incognito** in Claude, so your CV isn't saved to your history.
Take out your home address and phone number, but **leave your email in**: that's the line the AIs caught.

email.tested: When we tested it on 6 Nov, ChatGPT and Claude caught our planted email typo (gmial instead of gmail) straight away. Gemini missed it. So ask more than one AI: they catch different things.
email.safety: Use a temporary chat (incognito in Claude). Take out your home address and phone number, but leave your email in.
email.question: what job are you going for?
